messages:
maya: Quick UX check: QA found the reorder ghost overlaps neighbor badges in compact mode and the validator message shows a modal that feels heavy. need a lightweight approach.

hank: On compact the ghost has no outline; when it sits over badges they vanish. propose a semi-opaque ghost + 2px dashed border so badges remain readable.

claire: Also the validator currently throws a modal for priority conflicts. modal = interruptive. Suggest inline validator under the rule row with short copy + an inline action 'Auto-nudge'.

maya: Love inline action. Copy idea for inline: "Priority conflict: Two rules use priority 4. Use 'Auto-nudge' to bump lower rules down." Toast can remain but only as optional anchor saying "Conflict detected".

hank: For keyboard, the ghost outline must appear when dragging with keyboard invokes reorder mode. Use aria-grabbed and a visible focus ring on the ghost.

claire: Small microcopy tweak: change 'Expand' to 'Show details' and 'Collapse' to 'Hide details' for screen reader clarity.

ux-bot: Quick sim run queued: label="priority-nudge-ghosting" 15 runs at widths [375, 768].

maya: Also add a tiny animation reduction when prefers-reduced-motion is set (no ghost slide). keep interactions fast.

hank: I'll implement the ghost style + aria-grabbed and keyboard reorder hint. Will wire up Auto-nudge to the existing reorder API.

claire: I'll update copy in the design tokens doc and add the inline validator pattern to the component spec.

ux-bot: Simulation complete  15 runs, 0 failures. Label="priority-nudge-ghosting".

maya: Perfect. Small PR then merge. Thanks team!
